units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 32b:9">B. Kam. 32ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 19:5">Deut. XIX, 5</cite>) <he>ומה י׳ וכ׳</he> when in the case of unintentional homicide in the forest where each entered of his own accord &c.; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 182:1">Sifré Deut. 182</cite> <he>מה י׳ רשות וכ׳</he> as in the case … in the forest, both had a right to enter.
Cant. R. to III, 4, v. יְאוֹר; a. fr.—[יער, יאר = עור, אור, to break forth, applied to vegetation, water-course and light (cmp. נָהָר a. נְהוֹרָא); cmp. יְאוֹר a. Sam. יאר Gen. I, 11 for h. דשא.]
